items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We went to see Milt Jackson one time with Jimmy Heath and maybe Max, or somebody.

ctx.x: Well, you know we go to dances anyway. We even gave dances ourselves, so you know we did things like that. You know there might have been others – there were others. We went to see Milt Jackson one time with Jimmy Heath and maybe Max, or somebody.
